  • Method Details

    • isFavourite

      boolean isFavourite(Account account, int observationId)
      Checks whether the current user has favourited an observation.
      Parameters:
      account - account to check favourites of
      observationId - the ID of the observation
      Returns:
      true if it is one of the current user's favourites
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if nobody is logged in

    • setFavourite

      void setFavourite(Account account, int observationId, boolean favourite)
      Adds or removes a favourite for the current user.
      Parameters:
      account - account that owns the favourite
      observationId - the ID of the observation
      favourite - true to add the favourite, false to remove it
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if nobody is logged in

    • getFavouriteObservationIds

      Set<Integer> getFavouriteObservationIds(Account account)
      Parameters:
      account - the account whose favourites to load
      Returns:
      the IDs of every observation the account has favourited
